from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect

def test_login_flow(page: Page):
    page.goto('https://gc-dev.centralindia.cloudapp.azure.com/ambica/auth/login')
    page.fill('#username', 'd')
    page.fill('#password', '123456')
    page.click('button:has-text("Login")')
    page.wait_for_url('https://gc-dev.centralindia.cloudapp.azure.com/ambica/pages/home')
    expect(page.locator('h1')).to_contain_text('Good morning, d')
